title: FD&C Green No. 3 (Fast Green FCF): FDA Phase-Out, State Bans & Compliance Guide
excerpt: Green 3 is the least-used FDA-certified dye, now targeted for voluntary phase-out by end of 2026. State bans and reformulation guidance for affected manufacturers.
